Variants.Content: Heavy cavalry, elephants, infantry and siege forces have different needs. Horses, elephant food, equipment and transport make mobilization costly; eastern wars still leave western defence to supply.

Sasanian heavy cavalry, elephants, infantry and siege forces differ in needs. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Eastern wars still require western defence and supply.
